summary: Identifies the measurement connection associated with the selected neutral-earthing resistor system.
description: Identifies the measurement connection associated with the selected neutral-earthing resistor system. Earthing and lightning interfaces identify the connections between equipment metalwork, primary protection devices and the station earthing network. Their electrical purpose differs from their physical conductor route or electrode geometry.

In a switchyard arrangement, the earthing references help connect each primary equipment structure and surge-protection device to the correct earth-grid interface. Separate details show actual joints, sizes and installation routes. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Neutral-earthing circuit measurements” at the input and “Resistor system monitoring” at the output. Resistance and thermal duty follow the earthing design.
